one_line: Google adjusts school AI tools, Anthropic releases provable inference, AI security warnings rise, major AI deals announced.

themes.title: Google lets schools toggle AI tools
themes.text: Google announced that K‑12 administrators can turn off Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and AI features individually, but blocking AI also removes access to Google Search, which now always includes AI Mode and AI Overviews.

stories.headline: Google lets schools disable Gemini but forces AI in Search
Google lets schools enable Gemini, NotebookLM and Search separately after backlash

themes.title: Anthropic advances and staff changes
themes.text: Anthropic unveiled FlashProve, an open‑source system that generates cryptographic proofs for responses from Llama 4 Maverick, and announced the departure of two product team members who worked on Claude Code.

stories.headline: Anthropic releases FlashProve prototype for provable inference on Llama 4 Maverick
Cat Wu and Thariq Shihipar leave Anthropic product team for Claude Code

themes.title: AI‑driven fraud warnings and detection tools
themes.text: India's Cyber Crime Coordination Centre warned banks, NBFCs, and fintech firms about AI agents being used for fraudulent transactions and urged security measures, while Pangram released Image 1.0 and Image Flash 1.0 models claiming high detection accuracy for AI‑generated visuals.

stories.headline: India's cyber agency warns banks and fintechs of AI-driven fraud attacks
I4C warns Indian banks and fintechs of AI‑led cyberattacks
Pangram launches Image 1.0 and Image Flash 1.0 AI detection models

themes.title: Major AI infrastructure deals announced
themes.text: Traversal raised $120 million at a $1 billion valuation to expand its AI‑agent platform for site reliability engineering; CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Fiddler AI and Dreadnode for $495 million; AMD recorded a $1.1 billion non‑cash charge tied to AI chip warrants with OpenAI and Meta; and TeraWulf secured a Google credit backstop for its Kentucky data center linked to Anthropic lease commitments.

stories.headline: Traversal raises $120 million at $1 billion valuation to expand AI‑driven site reliability engineering
CrowdStrike to acquire Fiddler AI and Dreadnode for $495 million
AMD records $1.1 billion non‑cash charge from OpenAI, Meta AI chip warrants
TeraWulf secures Google credit backstop for Anthropic Kentucky data center project
